props.text: Choose a time online or call us. Urgent cases are seen the same day.

props.question: Can I get my results by phone?
props.answer: Yes. A nurse will call you and explain them.

props.question: Do I need an appointment?
props.answer: Appointments are best, but we see urgent cases the same day.

props.question: Which insurance do you accept?
props.answer: All major medical aid schemes, and we explain fees before treatment.

props.question: Are you open at weekends?
props.answer: Yes, every day from 7 am. Sundays until 1 pm.
